extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.notes: classic smoothly curved V shape in honey wood with an airfoil cross section (domed top, flat underside) and round tips; painted sky-blue and coral bands on both arms and a butter-yellow star at the elbow; lies flat on its flat side, elbow towards +Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
